name: microcosm
description: A sandbox for artificial organisms: a conserved-matter ecosystem simulator with an observatory that narrates what it sees.
//engines: Pinned deliberately, not conservatively (docs/android-port-plan.md M0). The certified fingerprints were captured on V8 12.4; Node >= 23 silently switches Math.pow to the host libm, and 2026 V8 moved sin/cos/exp/atan2 to LLVM-libc's correctly-rounded routines. A newer engine is a DIFFERENT oracle, not a better one. Probe: on an fdlibm-era V8, Math.pow(10,-5) !== 1e-5.

scripts.port:fingerprint: npm run build && node harness/fingerprint-raw.js 3000 && node harness/fingerprint-events.js
scripts.test:port: npm run wasm && npm run port:check && npm run port:snapshot && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/k6gate.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run syntax && node harness/selftest.js && node harness/conform.js && node harness/prose.js
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run tune && npm run gate && node harness/gate5.js && node harness/corridor.js --rails --fuzz && node harness/levels.js
